name: PRINCEPS
long_description: PRINCEPS is the first purpose-built insurance company for the trillion-dollar compute buildout. We underwrite SLA, GPU residual value, and outage risk, and price the coverage that unlocks cheaper financing for data centers and neoclouds.
one_liner: AI-native insurance company for the compute economy

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Co-Founder of PRINCEPS. Previously Treasurer of the Oxford Union (£3M+ institution). Experience from national Norwegian politics. Co-Founded an events company at whilst at Oxford University: scaled to 650+ tickets per event at £15K+ revenue. 
B.A Oxford (History & Politics)

founders.title: Founder/COO
founders.founder_bio: Co-Founder of PRINCEPS. Previously worked on data centre project finance, including a $2bn Gulf data centre deal and the first ever space data centre project, and built software for UK Parliament on energy and industrial policy. Youth Fellow at Chatham House researching defence and infrastructure security. Oxford Casberd academic Scholar and former VP of the Oxford Union ($3M+ institution). Designed and led a UN digital campaign at 16.
